layouts.spacing_system: Generous spacing. p-8, p-12, py-24 for sections.
layouts.hero: Full height 100vh with parallax Mars background, bold typography, and a prominent call to action.
layouts.bento_grid: Used for Tokenomics and Roadmap sections to organize content neatly amidst the chaotic meme vibe.

component_instructions.splash_screen: Create a full-screen intro animation (z-index: 100). A red car graphic zooms horizontally across the screen leaving an exhaust/gas trail. Delay 1.5s, then fade out the splash screen.
component_instructions.persistent_car: A car graphic fixed at the bottom center of the screen (z-index: 40). Apply a slight bobbing CSS animation (up/down) to simulate driving. The background sections act as the 'road' scrolling by.
component_instructions.copy_ca_pill: A glassmorphism pill showing the contract address with a copy icon. Needs hover states, a neon glow, and click animation.
component_instructions.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for a ticker that repeatedly says '$MARSter - THE ONLY CAR WITH GAS FEES ON MARS' across sections.

hero_headline.text: MARSter: the only car with gas fees on Mars

hero_subline.text: Leaving humans behind. Next stop: Mars.

lore_title.text: Earth is Over. We're on Mars now.

lore_body.text: While the humans cry about earth, we strapped a rocket to a roadster and sent it to the red planet.

image_urls.description: Sleek red sports car. Apply a mask or clipping path to isolate it as the flying/driving Roadster.
Barren rocky desert landscape resembling Mars surface.
Milky way starry sky for space sections and transition backgrounds.
Crying woman representing the humans left behind on Earth.

conversion_wiring.behavior: When clicked, copy the placeholder CA to clipboard and show a success toast using Sonner.

motion_and_interactions.intro_splash: Use Framer Motion. 100vw red car zips left to right leaving a trail, delays 1.5s, then opacity fades to 0 to reveal site.
motion_and_interactions.on_scroll: Parallax effects on Mars background. Car element sticks to bottom of screen and jiggles slightly as if driving over bumps.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons glow with neon cyan/red drop-shadow on hover. Elements scale up slightly.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion for the splash screen and scroll animations. Splash screen should hide overflow.
For the persistent car, create a fixed container at the bottom of the viewport with z-index 40. Apply an up/down bobbing animation to the car image to simulate driving.
Ensure the hero background is dark enough for the text to be readable. Use black gradients at the bottom of sections to blend them into the next.
Implement a marquee for the token name/slogan to add degen energy.
DO NOT use a plain background; always use the space/stars or mars images with a heavy dark overlay.
Make the Copy CA button massive and obvious.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications when the CA is copied.
Make sure all texts are styled according to the typography guidelines, with glowing effects on accents.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
